question: A farkon zangon makaranta, wata malamar makarantar reno tana son tantance manufar koyo mai zuwa daga sashin Harsunan Fasaha: "Nuna sha'awa ga sautuka ta hanyar amsawa da nau'o'i daban-daban, kamar rero, alamomi, murmushi, da sauransu." Wace ce dabarar tantancewa mafi dacewa ga wannan halin da aka bayyana?
answer_a: Bawa yara busa-busa da garayu, jira ka lura yadda suke sarrafa su
answer_b: Ku gabatar da 'yan maru a daban-daban ga yara, ku yi amfani da su wajen yin sauti, sannan ku bar su a hannunsu
answer_c: Ku nuna wa yara wani abu mai fitar da sauti sannan ku rufe shi da zane kuma ku jira su neme shi
answer_d: Bari yaran su ga hotuna daban-daban na dabbobin gida don yin kwaikwayon sautinsu (onomatopoeia) masu dacewa

question: Malamin aji na biyar yana son ɗalibansa su tantance, bisa ga wani tarin kiɗa, waƙoƙin da suke cikin muhallinsu na yau da kullum. Wace irin aiki ce ta dace ga ɗaliban don su cimma wannan manufa da aka ambata?
answer_a: Shirya jerin waƙoƙi dangane da bayanai da aka tsamo daga hirarraki
answer_b: Bincika wani maudu'i da ke magana a kan kiɗan birni da tasirinsa a kan al'ummar zamani
answer_c: Sake kirkira ko fassara shahararrun waƙoƙi daga tarin waƙoƙin matasa daban-daban waɗanda suke wakiltar su
answer_d: Yi bincike kan maƙwabtansu kuma ku tattara bayanai game da sha'awar kiɗan da ke wanzuwa a cikin unguwanninsu

question: Wacece a cikin waɗannan ayyukan kimantawa na gaba, da aka gudanar kafin gina shigarwar rukuni, zai taimaka wa ɗalibai su gane matakin nasarar ayyukansu?
answer_a: Ta hanyar tattaunawa, suna kimanta zane-zanen ayyukansu, suna tattauna yaren gani da aka gabatar.
answer_b: Suna nazarin ayyukansu, suna gano daidaituwa tsakanin ra'ayoyinsu, abubuwan zahiri, da kuma zaɓaɓɓen yaren gani.
answer_c: Suna tantance kayan da aka yi amfani da su a shigarwar masu fasaha na zamani, kuma suna gwada bambancinsu da waɗanda aka zaɓa a cikin ayyukansu
answer_d: Suna koyon ayyukan shigarwa da aka gudanar a wasu cibiyoyi sannan su bincika su ta mahangar harshen gani
